values.note: Single site $10 a night, double site $15 (recreation.gov rate table, seasons through 2028). The fee covers 2 vehicles maximum.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10207708/rates (Peak Season 2026-10-01 - 2026-12-31 and 2027-01-01 - 2027-05-31: PeakSingleSite $10, PeakDoubleSite $15) + notice 'Camping fee covers 2 vehicles maximum', read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/lake-eaton-campground ('No hookups available.') + RIDB catalog for 10207708 (all 14 sites 'STANDARD NONELECTRIC', 'Water Hookup: No'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 14 primitive tent & RV sites (13 reservable on recreation.gov); rec.gov driveway lengths 34-62 ft.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/lake-eaton-campground ('Tent & RV primitive campsites: 14 sites in the campground') + RIDB catalog (13 of 14 reservable, Driveway Length 34-62), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/lake-eaton-campground ('Vault toilets'; 'Potable water is not available at this site.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10207708 (amenities 'Vault Toilets', 'Boat Ramp'), read 2026-10-21

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/lake-eaton-campground ('Seasons of Use: October 1 - June 1'; 'Open seasonally'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve on Recreation.gov or at (877) 444-6777. 14 consecutive days in any 30-day period across all Ocala NF campgrounds. Main entrance gate open 8 a.m. to 8 p.m.; check-in 3 p.m., check-out 11 a.m. Weekends fill. A rented RV may not be delivered; the reservation holder must drive it in.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10207708 (notices 'Main entrance gate opens from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m.', 'Check in- 3 p.m. Check out- 11 a.m.', '14 day stay limit'; 'For reservations or refund request please call (877) 444-6777') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/lake-eaton-campground ('Maximum stay limit of 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period', 'Expect full recreation sites during weekends'), read 2026-10-21

note: USFS Ocala NF campground in the Big Scrub on 308-acre Lake Eaton, with a boat ramp, accessible fishing pier and interpretive trail. Access via FR 44 is unimproved/rutted with dips, but firsthand reports note 30+ ft rigs camp here.
summary: Forest page + recreation.gov: confirmed $10 single site, 14 non-electric sites, no hookups, rec.gov booking, 14-night limit. Added season October 1 - June 1, vault toilets, no potable water, booking notes. Note cleaned of the site/booking/season/stay-limit text the fields carry.
flags: Phone: 877-444-6777 is recreation.gov's reservation line; rec.gov gives (352) 625-2520 for general information.
